root_cause: many-body sector dimension and iterative ground-state computation cost, not a fixed-size buffer bug or incorrect gap conventions
interpretation: The same correct solver retains near-exact accuracy over the complete new hidden batch, but uses more than eight times the inference CPU budget. This supports a genuine accuracy-versus-computation ratchet; it does not establish that a budget-valid predictor exists or is impossible. Relaxed-control CPU placement differs from official CPU 188, and its time is not an official score.
